en.text:
Several chairs around a table.
A mess hall, perhaps a lounge...

More urgent than the furniture was the man in the corner.
League uniform, worn very untidily—◆enemy territory ought to contain enemy soldiers, and here was one, fulfilling the expectation!

I took my stance at once. Ready for hostility to stop being an idea.

en.html:
I gathered myself and addressed him. No improvement in the drunkard. Cheap liquor went down; something loud and shapeless came out. Fast English, with the pronunciation having dissolved. My English was already limited; with this additional service, I could not understand even half. Bhai, slowly. One surviving consonant, at least. Give the foreign listener something to hold. But no, the whole sentence came sliding out boneless, and I had to catch its meaning before it hit the floor. Abuse, apparently, mixed with demands to bring him something...? For now, leave him. Why Cannon’s top-secret operation required this particular sample of humanity, I did wish to know. But first count the blessing: no fight. A door stood in the wall toward the bow. That way, or back to the corridor.
Choices
  • Through the door toward the bow.
  • Back to the corridor.

Kanae"Lieutenant Colonel Cannon meant to requisition the ship alone for the operation. This gentleman objected and forced his way aboard. After all that, they still would not let him take part. So here he is, holding a one-man protest in liquid form."

Sayo"A cruel arrangement by the lieutenant colonel. An airship captain’s love for the ship can hardly be less than that of a captain at sea."

Kanae"Liquor. “How am I to get drunk on this watery imitation of ale? Bring gin from the homeland.” Those are his words."
Kageaki"..."
Sayo"Asking is very easy, of course."
